lines.en: label kirinspring1:
scene noonsky
I’m minding my own business when, suddenly, my phone rings.
lines.zh: 我正自顾自地待着，突然，手机响了。

lines.en: And while this would not be anything worth noting on its own, I figured I’d let {i}you{/i} know since Kirin is the one calling and that probably means I’m going to have sex.
lines.zh: 这事本身没什么值得记的，不过我觉得还是告诉{i}你{/i}一声——因为是 Kirin 打来的，那大概意味着我要做爱了。

lines.en: : Hey.
: Hi! What are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 嗨！你现在在干什么？

lines.en: : Castrating myself. Sorry to ruin your plans for the day.
lines.zh: : 给自己做绝育手术。抱歉破坏了你今天的计划。

lines.en: : Can I keep what’s lopped off as a souvenir? A memento of all the great times we once had?
lines.zh: : 切下来的那部分能留给我当纪念品吗？纪念我们曾经拥有的美好时光？

lines.en: : Sure. Just make sure you split the memento with Noriko since she never got to have actual sex with me.
lines.zh: : 可以。不过记得把纪念品分 Noriko 一半，毕竟她从来没能真的跟我上床。

lines.en: : Bad decisions aside, come meet up with me.
lines.zh: : 抛开糟糕的决定不谈，来见我。

lines.en: : But you just said “bad decisions aside” and that is very obviously a bad decision.
lines.zh: : 可你刚说了“抛开糟糕的决定”，而这明显就是个糟糕的决定。

lines.en: : Why is it a bad decision? What is that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 为什么是糟糕的决定？这话什么意思？

lines.en: : It’s supposed to be an acknowledgment of how improper our relationship is. But I guess that wouldn’t click for someone who can’t grasp the concept of that.
lines.zh: : 意思是承认我们之间的关系有多不正当。不过对一个根本抓不住这个概念的人，大概也听不进去。

lines.en: : Oh, lame. Well, we’re going on a date and you can’t say no. Meet me near my place in an hour.
lines.zh: : 哦，真没劲。算了，我们要去约会，你不准说不。一小时后来我家附近找我。

lines.en: : I don’t like this assertiveness. Bring back the cute Kirin who says cute things and wears that very tight dress.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这么强势。把那个说可爱话、穿那条紧身裙的可爱 Kirin 还给我。

lines.en: : Mmmmm no. Bye!
scene black
Kirin hangs up the phone and I guess I now have something (or someone) to do this afternoon.
lines.zh: Kirin 挂了电话，看来我今天下午有事（或者说有人）要做了。

lines.en: Was I {i}planning{/i} on getting laid today? No. But I never really plan on doing that since it always sort of happens no matter {i}what{/i} I do. And today will be no exception.
lines.zh: 我本来{i}打算{/i}今天上床吗？没有。不过我也从来不真的计划这种事，因为不管我{i}做什么{/i}它总会发生。今天也不例外。

lines.en: scene thegreatbluehole
{b}which is good because i keep thinking about the clockless watch on my baby-like wrist//how the bones don’t fit like they did in her{/b}
lines.zh: {b}这也挺好，因为我一直在想我那婴儿般手腕上的无指针之表//想那些骨头已经不像在她身上时那样契合{/b}

lines.en: scene black
{b}{size=+20}WHAT AM I SUPPOSED TO DO NOW??????{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+20}我现在该怎么办？？？？？？{/size}{/b}

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo1
: Oh, good! You made it.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了！你来了。

lines.en: : And only had one mental breakdown on the way.
lines.zh: : 而且一路上只精神崩溃了一次。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo2
: As if {i}you{/i} have anything worth being tormented over when you live in a world where everyone will still want to fuck you no matter {i}what{/i} you do.
lines.zh: : 说得好像{i}你{/i}有什么值得被折磨的事一样——毕竟在这个世界上，不管你{i}做什么{/i}，大家照样都想操你。

lines.en: : You have no idea how accurate that is.
lines.zh: : 你说得有多准，你根本想象不到。

lines.en: : Also, aren’t you supposed to be weirdly in-tune with mental impairments and {i}not{/i} the type to accuse someone of being too privileged to bypass them?
lines.zh: : 还有，你不是应该对精神障碍格外敏感吗？而{i}不是{/i}那种指责别人运气太好、可以绕开它们的人。

lines.en: : You know, I’m really glad you mentioned {i}tune,{/i} because that’s pretty relevant to what I wanted to do today!
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我真高兴你提到了“{i}调{/i}”，因为那跟我今天想做的事很有关系！

lines.en: : No, I will not teach you how to play the piano. Ask someone else.
lines.zh: : 不，我不会教你弹钢琴。问别人去。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo3
: You know how to play the piano?
lines.zh: : 你会弹钢琴？

lines.en: : No — which is why I won’t teach you.
lines.zh: : 不会——所以我不教你。

lines.en: : Damn. I was actually a little impressed for a second.
lines.zh: : 靠。我刚才还真有点佩服你。

lines.en: : Well, you shouldn’t be. I am talentless and miserable and only good for inducing orgasms.
lines.zh: : 你不该佩服。我毫无才华、又惨，唯一的用处就是能带来高潮。

lines.en: : Well, at least we have that in common. Now, come with me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这点我们至少一样。那么，跟我来。

lines.en: : Where?
lines.zh: : 去哪儿？

lines.en: : To wherever the fuck I want to go. It’s my date. And I literally just gave you a hint.
lines.zh: : 去我想去的他妈的任何地方。这是我的约会。而且我刚刚明明给了你提示。

lines.en: : Yes, but the only answer I can come up with in regard to that hint is a place I definitely don’t want to go.
lines.zh: : 是，可关于那个提示，我唯一能想到的答案，是一个我绝对不想去的地方。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo4
: Well, that’s too bad because it isn’t up to you!
lines.zh: : 那太遗憾了，因为这由不得你！

lines.en: : Kirin-
lines.zh: : Kirin——

lines.en: scene noonsky
: This way, Sensei! I’ve already called ahead and reserved a time-slot for us!
lines.zh: : 这边走，老师！我已经提前打电话订好时间段了！

lines.en: : You’ve had this planned the whole time?
lines.zh: : 你从头到尾都计划好了？

lines.en: : Mhm! I just really feel like singing today! And you’ve never gotten to hear my voice either! So, come on! It’ll be fun!
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！我今天就是特别想唱歌！而且你也从来没听过我唱歌！所以，来嘛！会很好玩的！

lines.en: : What if I never showed up?...
lines.zh: : 要是我根本没来呢？……

lines.en: : Then I’d just have to go alone!
lines.zh: : 那我就自己去呗！

lines.en: : Or find another random boy who wants to come with me. But hey! Nothing bad ever happens in karaoke booths, right?
lines.zh: : 或者随便找一个愿意陪我来的男生。不过嘿！卡拉 OK 包厢里从来不会发生什么坏事，对吧？

lines.en: : Senseiiiii! Let’s gooooooo!~
lines.zh: : 老师～～～走啦走啦～！

lines.en: scene black
She knows.
lines.zh: 她知道。

lines.en: There’s no way she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 她不可能不知道。

lines.en: But how did she find out?...
lines.zh: 可她是怎么发现的？……

lines.en: She and Karin aren’t the type who actually {i}talk{/i} to one another now...are they?
lines.zh: 她和 Karin 现在不是那种真的会{i}互相说话{/i}的关系……对吧？

lines.en: And if they {i}are{/i} talking, why does Kirin even care?
lines.zh: 而如果她们{i}真的在{/i}说话，Kirin 又为什么要在意？

lines.en: Is it just jealousy?
lines.zh: 只是嫉妒吗？

lines.en: Is she only grilling me about this because she wanted to be {i}there{/i} for it?
lines.zh: 她抓着这事审我，只是因为她当时想{i}在场{/i}吗？

lines.en: I don’t know...and she’s so busy dragging me down the road like an oversized doll that I don’t even have time to wrap my head around it.
lines.zh: 我不知道……而她正忙着像个超大号玩偶一样拖着我沿路走，我连理清头绪的时间都没有。

lines.en: My hands begin to sweat. She notices. She wipes hers off before repeating that same contact again.
lines.zh: 我的手开始出汗。她注意到了。她先把手擦干，然后又握了上来。

lines.en: She keeps doing it. Hand to hand. Skirt. Awkward stare upward. Hands again. I’m in trouble.
lines.zh: 她一直重复这个动作。手贴着手。裙子。尴尬地抬眼看我。又是手。我有麻烦了。

lines.en: No. It’s not trouble. It’s jealousy. Hands again. Skirt.
lines.zh: 不。不是麻烦。是嫉妒。又是手。裙子。

lines.en: : Something wrong, Sensei? You seem a little more nervous than usual.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，老师？你看起来比平时紧张多了。

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: I’m fine.
lines.zh: 我没事。

lines.en: : You’re fine?
lines.zh: : 你没事？

lines.en: I’m fine.
lines.zh: 我没事。

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: I’m not fine.
lines.zh: 我不好。

lines.en: But I should be fine because this is a thing I’m fine with now and it doesn’t matter if I hurt Karin since Karin is just a side character and I don’t need her to progress. Right, Pareidolia?
lines.zh: 可我应该没事才对，因为这是我现在已经能接受的事了；而且就算伤了 Karin 也无所谓，因为 Karin 不过是个配角，我不需要她来推进剧情。对吧，Pareidolia？

lines.en: {b}wrong.{/i}
lines.zh: {b}wrong.{/b}

lines.en: Shit.
lines.zh: 操。

lines.en: {b}when you were younger, you loved cereal.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你小的时候，很喜欢吃麦片。{/b}

lines.en: scene cereaaal
I did?
lines.zh: 是吗？

lines.en: {b}yeah. you loved the little toys that came in the little boxes.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}对。你喜欢小盒子里送的小玩具。{/b}

lines.en: {b}and you were the type of spoiled brat who was never okay with only having one of them. so you wanted to collect them all.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}而你又是那种被宠坏的小屁孩，从来不满足只拥有一个。所以你想把它们全收集齐。{/b}

lines.en: That doesn’t sound like me.
lines.zh: 这听起来不像我。

lines.en: {b}you have no idea what you actually sound like since you’re always focusing on bone conduction rather than the product of your voice and the air.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你根本不知道自己真正的声音是什么样的，因为你总是把注意力放在骨传导上，而不是你的声音与空气共同作用的产物。{/b}

lines.en: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: {b}think of it like this, akira. the you inside of you is a different you from the you outside of you.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}这么想吧，akira。你里面的那个你，和你外面的那个你是不同的你。{/b}

lines.en: {b}and the you outside of you isn’t as much of a bitch as the you inside of you.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}而你外面的那个你，可没有你里面的那个你那么 bitch。{/b}

lines.en: Okay, but what does that have to do with cereal?
lines.zh: 好吧，可这跟麦片有什么关系？

lines.en: {b}i’d have gotten to that part already if you hadn’t interrupted me.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你要是没打断我，我早就讲到那部分了。{/b}

lines.en: I’m sorry. I’m a bad boy.
lines.zh: 对不起。我是个坏孩子。

lines.en: {b}only because you keep focusing on bone conduction. but that’s beside the point.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}只因为你总盯着骨传导不放。不过这不是重点。{/b}

lines.en: {b}you loved cereal. but cereal is bad for your teeth. it can turn them into liquid. and your mother wanted to protect you from liquid teeth.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你喜欢麦片。可麦片对牙齿不好。它会让你的牙齿化成液体。而你母亲想保护你不长出液体牙齿。{/b}

lines.en: {b}your father had a sweet tooth as well. but his vice was candy, not cereal.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你父亲也嗜甜。不过他的癖好是糖果，不是麦片。{/b}

lines.en: I don’t remember my father.
lines.zh: 我不记得我父亲。

lines.en: {b}no one does.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}没人记得。{/b}

lines.en: I don’t remember my mother either.
lines.zh: 我也不记得我母亲。

lines.en: {b}yeah. well a mixture of childhood trauma and timeline fuckery will do that. BUT ANYWAY, CEREAL.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}是啊。童年的创伤加上时间线乱七八糟，就会这样。不过总之，麦片。{/b}

lines.en: Sorry, Pareidolia.
lines.zh: 抱歉，Pareidolia。

lines.en: {b}even today, you want to collect them all.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}直到今天，你还是想把它们全部收集齐。{/b}

lines.en: {b}and no matter how many times you tell yourself you don’t, you know you’re wrong.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}不管你告诉自己多少次你不想，你心里清楚自己错了。{/b}

lines.en: {b}you’ll regret that one day. but you’ll live in bliss for now, pretending to be a better man than you actually are — which isn’t so much of a man at all.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}总有一天你会后悔的。不过现在你会活在幸福里，假装自己是个比实际更好的人——而那人根本算不上什么好人。{/b}

lines.en: {b}you’re just a little boy with a walk-in toy box. and if you want to play with something, you CAN.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}你只是个拥有步入式玩具箱的小男孩。而如果你想玩点什么，你完全可以。{/b}

lines.en: Okay. I’m sorry for talking back, Pareidolia.
lines.zh: 好吧。我为顶嘴道歉，Pareidolia。

lines.en: {b}don’t apologize to me — apologize to kirin for almost raping her big sister.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}别跟我道歉——去跟 kirin 道歉，因为你差点强奸了她姐姐。{/b}

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo5
{b}THEN TELL HER TO FUCK OFF AND STOP GETTING IN THE WAY OF WHAT NEEDS TO BE DONE{/b}
lines.zh: {b}那就叫她滚蛋，别再挡着该做的事{/b}

lines.en: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa shit
lines.zh: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa 操

lines.en: : Well, we’re here!
lines.zh: : 好啦，我们到了！

lines.en: : I wonder what song I should sing first?
lines.zh: : 我该先唱哪首歌呢？

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo6
: Any preference, Sensei? Is there a certain genre you try to stick to when you come here with other girls?
lines.zh: : 老师有偏好吗？你跟别的女孩来这儿的时候，会不会固定唱某种类型？

lines.en: : I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: : You {i}don’t{/i} come here with other girls? Really? Because that’s not what I heard, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你{i}不{/i}跟别的女孩来这儿？真的吗？可我听到的不是这样啊，老师。

lines.en: : I don’t...have a genre I try to stick to...
lines.zh: : 我……没有固定要唱的类型……

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo7
: Oooooh! {i}That’s{/i} what you meant!
lines.zh: : 哦————————！{i}你原来是{/i}这个意思！

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo8
: Sorry. Guess I got a little ahead of myself there.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我刚才有点得意忘形了。

lines.en: : Something wrong, Sensei? It’s not like you to be so {i}uncomfortable{/i} in a dark room with a defenseless girl.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，老师？在一个黑屋子里跟一个毫无防备的女孩独处，你可不常这么{i}不自在{/i}。

lines.en: : And it’s not like you to beat around the bush instead of saying what you really want to say.
lines.zh: : 而且你也不常拐弯抹角，不把真正想说的话说出来。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo9
: No. I guess it’s not, is it?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我想，确实不常。

lines.en: : I guess we’re {i}both{/i} dealing with something we’re not really sure of how to handle then, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来{i}我们俩{/i}都在应付某种自己不太确定该怎么处理的东西，对吧？

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo10
: Ahh...this is so annoying. I hate having to be the good guy.
lines.zh: : 啊……真烦。我讨厌非得当这个好人。

lines.en: : But having a story arc without some sort of hero in it just doesn’t make much sense, huh?
lines.zh: : 可一个没有某种英雄的故事线，也说不太通，对吧？

lines.en: : We can’t {i}both{/i} be villains this time, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这次我们不能{i}两个都{/i}当反派，老师。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo11
: And it is for that reason that I must ask you what you did to my sister.
lines.zh: : 也正是因为这一点，我必须问你，你对我姐姐做了什么。

lines.en: : You have to...
lines.zh: : 你得……

lines.en: : You have to...{i}ask{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 你得……{i}问{/i}我？

lines.en: : You don’t already know?
lines.zh: : 你不是已经知道了吗？

lines.en: : I know that {i}something{/i} happened. And I know that she’s really beaten up over it. But all I have to work with is context.
lines.zh: : 我知道发生了{i}什么事{/i}。我也知道她为此痛苦得不行。可我手里只有上下文。

lines.en: : And the context that I {i}do{/i} have, Sensei...it doesn’t paint a very good picture.
lines.zh: : 而我手里{i}这点{/i}上下文，老师……拼出来的画面可不太好看。

lines.en: : This is the part where I tell you to hurry up and spit it out since we only have this room for two hours and I don’t have time to watch you hesitate for the next ninety minutes.
lines.zh: : 现在是我催你赶紧招的时候了，因为我们只有这间房两个小时，我可没时间看你接下来九十分钟一直犹豫。

lines.en: : Why do you even care?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么要在意？

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo12
: What do you mean, {i}why do I care?{/i}
lines.zh: : 什么叫“{i}我为什么要在意{/i}”？

lines.en: : I mean you’re the same girl who routinely gets turned on by the thought of me treating everyone you know like human-sized tissues I can soak up my cum with before tossing aside.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你不就是那个一想到我把你认识的每个人当成人体大小的纸巾、吸干精液再丢掉，就会兴奋的女孩吗。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo13
: Wha...since when?!
lines.zh: : 什……从什么时候开始的？！

lines.en: : Since I first met you. But you can go ahead and pretend you were never like that since I don’t want to ruin your “good girl” arc when it’s just getting started.
lines.zh: : 从我一认识你开始。不过你大可以继续装作自己从来不是那样，因为我可不想毁掉你刚起步的“好女孩”故事线。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo14
: Wow. Okay. So {i}that’s{/i} how we’re going to do this, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。好吧。所以{i}我们要这么搞{/i}，是吧？

lines.en: : How else would you prefer? Because tricking me into thinking we were hanging out before luring me into a place I’m not comfortable with doesn’t exactly scream “friendly chat” to me.
lines.zh: : 那你希望怎么搞？因为先骗我以为我们只是出来玩，再把我引到一个我不自在的地方，这可不像是什么“友好谈心”。

lines.en: : Did you stop to think that maybe me doing that should have given you the hint you needed to confess without me having to force it out of you?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过，我这么做本来就该给你需要的暗示，让你自己招出来，而不是非得逼你？

lines.en: : I did. But then you immediately started trying to force it out of me without giving me {i}any time at all{/i} to tell you what happened on my own.
lines.zh: : 我想过。可紧接着你就开始逼我，压根{i}不给我时间{/i}自己把事情说出来。

lines.en: : Well, {i}would{/i} you? Because you’ve had a long fucking time since shit happened to do just that and all you’ve done is leave me in the dark.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你会{/i}说吗？因为事情发生之后你有的是他妈的时间可以那么做，可你做的只是把我蒙在鼓里。

lines.en: : I’m not sure. Maybe? Want to spend the next ninety minutes listening to me hesitate before finding out?
lines.zh: : 我不确定。也许吧？要不要花接下来九十分钟听我犹豫，然后再听结果？

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo15
: You’re {i}spicy{/i} today. All that quarantining get you a little pent up? Is {i}that{/i} why you raped my sister? Couldn’t hold back anymore?
lines.zh: : 你今天{i}火气真大{/i}。隔离把你憋坏了？{i}所以你才{/i}强奸了我姐姐？忍不住了？

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}rape{/i} your sister, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}强奸{/i}你姐姐，Kirin。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo16
: Because my good boy would never {i}rape{/i} someone! He’d just convince them that they {i}want{/i} to have sex. Right, Aki-kun?
lines.zh: : 因为我的好孩子绝不会{i}强奸{/i}别人！他只会说服对方相信她们{i}想{/i}做爱。对吧，Aki-kun？

lines.en: : Wait, you didn’t?
lines.zh: : 等等，你没有？

lines.en: {i}Ignore Her...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}别理她……{/i}

lines.en: : Well...what the fuck’s she so beaten up about then?
lines.zh: : 那……她到底为了什么那么痛苦？

lines.en: : Have you not talked to your sister {i}at all?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你跟你姐姐{i}一点都没{/i}聊过？

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo17
: No, because she won’t fucking {i}tell{/i} me anything! I had to find out from Miku that you two came here together! But ever since she came back, she’s seemed friggin’ traumatized!
lines.zh: : 没有，因为她他妈的一个字都不肯{i}告诉{/i}我！我是从 Miku 那儿才知道你们俩来了这儿！可她回来之后，整个人就像受了创伤一样！

lines.en: : Aki-kun, what’s your childhood friend’s band called again? I wanna sing one of her songs.
lines.zh: : Aki-kun，你那个青梅竹马的乐队叫什么来着？我想唱她的一首歌。

lines.en: : Oh, nevermind. Found it! Forgot she was an idol. I should’ve been one of those. Idols can get away with anything.
lines.zh: : 哦，算了。找到了！忘了她是个偶像了。我当初也该当偶像的。偶像干什么都能被原谅。

lines.en: : Kirin...just because I didn’t do anything to Karin doesn’t mean I didn’t {i}want{/i} to. That’s what she’s probably traumatized about.
lines.zh: : Kirin……我没对 Karin 做什么，不代表我没{i}想过{/i}要做。她大概是为此感到创伤的。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo18
: But...nothing actually {i}happened?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可……{i}其实什么都没发生{/i}？

lines.en: : No. I ran away like a little bitch after a failed and somewhat subconscious attempt at coercing her into taking her clothes off for me.
lines.zh: : 没有。在一次失败的、有点下意识的、想哄她为我脱掉衣服的尝试之后，我像个胆小鬼一样跑了。

lines.en: : Some girls just don’t understand what a catch you are, Aki-kun! It’s okay!
lines.zh: : 有些女孩就是不懂你有多抢手，Aki-kun！没关系的！

lines.en: : You still like...touched her, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 不过你还是……碰了她，对吧？

lines.en: : There was some grappling involved. We may have ended up on the floor.
lines.zh: : 有一些肢体纠缠。我们可能最后倒在了地上。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo19
: So...the two of you came here together...you tried to get into her pants...brought her to the ground...and then ran away before actually getting into them?
lines.zh: : 所以……你们俩一起来了这儿……你想扒掉她的裤子……把她按在地上……然后在真得手之前跑了？

lines.en: : Yup.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo20
: Oh.
: Well, that’s not nearly as bad as I expected. But still, keep your hands off of Karin.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这比我预想的要好得多。不过话说回来，还是把你的手从 Karin 身上拿开。

lines.en: : I don’t think my putting my hands {i}on{/i} her is much of an option anymore, to be honest. She basically told me she doesn’t want anything to do with me anymore.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我觉得我再把手{i}放到{/i}她身上已经没什么可能了。她基本上已经跟我说，她不想再跟我有任何瓜葛。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo21
: Well...good for her, I guess. But it’s kind of fucked up that you even {i}tried{/i} getting with her in the first place when you can use me for that stuff any time you want.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那对她来说大概是好事吧。不过你一开始居然{i}想去招惹{/i}她，这也挺操蛋的——这种事你随时都可以找我啊。

lines.en: : There’s the Kirin I know.
lines.zh: : 这才是我认识的 Kirin。

lines.en: : I never went anywhere. But where’s the Sensei {i}I{/i} know? You’ve been fuckin’...weird all afternoon.
lines.zh: : 我又没跑掉。可{i}我{/i}认识的那个老师去哪了？你整个下午都他妈的……怪怪的。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo22
: I’m right here.
lines.zh: : 我就在这儿。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo23
: Me too! I wanna see if you’ve learned any new tricks while I’ve been getting eaten by worms.
lines.zh: : 我也是！我想看看在我被虫子吃掉的时候，你有没有学到什么新花样。

lines.en: : Wha...is this seriously the time for this? I’m trying to, like...scold you and stuff.
lines.zh: : 什……现在是说这个的时候吗？我正在……训你什么的。

lines.en: : It’s nice that you’re trying to be a good sister for once. I’ve always thought you’re the cutest when you’re trying to do the right thing.
lines.zh: : 你难得想当一次好姐姐，这挺好。我一直觉得你努力做正确的事的时候最可爱。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo24
: And now you’re just...saying stuff you know will get to me. That’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 你现在就……专挑你知道能戳到我的话说。这不公平。

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : If you had been there with us, I don’t know if I’d have ever touched Karin at all.
lines.zh: : 如果当时你也在，我不知道自己还会不会去碰 Karin。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo25
: Can I really use you “any time I want,” Kirin?
lines.zh: : 我真的可以“随时”用你吗，Kirin？

lines.en: : Can I use you right now?...
lines.zh: : 我现在能用你吗？……

lines.en: : Will you get off from being fucked in the same spot where I almost took your big sister?
lines.zh: : 在我差点上了你姐姐的那个地方被操，你会爽吗？

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo26
: You’ve always wanted to...{i}explore{/i} with her, haven’t you? Are you just pretending to be mad because I almost took that opportunity from you?
lines.zh: : 你一直想……和她一起{i}探索{/i}，对吧？你是不是只是装生气，因为我差点把那个机会从你手里抢走？

lines.en: : You’re being {i}too{/i} spicy now. I don’t like this.
lines.zh: : 你现在火气{i}太大{/i}了。我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : Why not?

lines.en: : Because it’s fucking weird, that’s why.
lines.zh: : 因为这他妈很奇怪，就是这样。

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo27
: I get that shit’s been hard or whatever. But if that’s the truth, I want to {i}see{/i} that. And all I see right now is some douchebag trying to talk his way out of trouble.
lines.zh: : 我知道这段时间日子不好过什么的。可如果那是真的，我想{i}看到{/i}的是那个。而我现在看到的，只是个想靠嘴皮子摆脱麻烦的混蛋。

lines.en: : I know I’ve probably said some shitty things before...and I even probably meant them in the moment, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道我以前大概说过些难听的话……而且当时大概还是真心的，不过……

lines.en: : If you’re going to fuck my big sister, just...make sure it’s consensual, okay?
lines.zh: : 如果你真要操我姐姐，就……确保是双方自愿的，好吗？

lines.en: scene kirinmadyo28
: I don’t want to, like...deal with her acting all sad at home and shit.

lines.en: : Kirin.
